description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the distribution of “Stimulus Type,” showing 10 labeled categories with percentages printed next to each slice and the title text “Stimulus Type” centered in the hole. The slices are: Draft/Other (26.4%) in dark red; Press Release (18.7%) in mustard yellow; External News Article (18.1%) in dark green; Interview (8.8%) in dark navy; Organizational Report (7.7%) in purple; Event Posting (6.6%) in maroon; Organizational Website (4.9%) in light lavender; Intra-agency news article (4.9%) in medium blue; Email (2.7%) in light green; and Social Media Post (1.1%) in a very thin orange slice. There is no separate legend; labels and percentages are placed outside the ring, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
